_comment: #156: where the download button sends a page, and which sites default to Adult/Short. Copied from the Dashboard's yt-dlp page (Dashboard/static/yt-dlp.html, its SITES list), which makes the same call by domain. Both apps read this one file. #176: the adult list also decides which tabs close the moment you leave them, never sync, and never restore.
_adultWords: #183: a host label CONTAINING one of these is adult too, so sites nobody listed still count. Words that also live in ordinary names (sex: sussex/essex, adult: adultswim) are deliberately absent.
_adultOrigins: #191: host:port pairs that are adult. 100.69.184.113 hosts every app, so MuseForge's Studio (:8005) and Stash (:9999, #193) can only be named with their port; the other ports there stay normal.
